source_refs.note: 5- Inhalants: a main subheading of 15.7.2 Use and Abuse of Drugs, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 49-49.

blocks.text: Inhalants, jaise nail polish remover aur gond (glue), psychoactive madde hain jinhein sarsoor, sukoon aur badli hui samajh ke liye soongha jata hai. Yeh sehat ke kai nuqsanat la sakte hain, jaise saans ke masail, soch ki kamzori aur asabi (neurological) nuqsan.

Drug abuse chhorne ki alamaat mein ghabrahat (anxiety), depression, thakan, be-chaini (agitation), mizaj ka baar baar badalna, kapkapi, sar dard, paseena, matli (nausea), bhook khatam hona, be-khwabi, dil ki tez dharkan, high blood pressure, waham (hallucinations: dekhne, sunne ya chhoone ke) aur dauray (seizures) shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Morphine ke use aur abuse mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Use: doctor shadeed dard ke liye naapi hui khuraak mein morphine tajweez karta hai. Abuse: tibbi zaroorat ke baghair sarsoor ke liye lena, jo dependence aur lat tak le jata hai.

items: Use = tibbi, tajweez kardah istemal; abuse = psychoactive drugs ka na-munasib istemal. Heroin (afeem se), cannabis (Cannabis sativa), nicotine (tambakoo), alcohol aur inhalants (nail polish remover, gond) sab sehat ko nuqsan dete hain; chhorne par bohat si withdrawal symptoms.
